synopsis: Synopsys acquired Ansys on 17 July 2025 for roughly USD 35 billion; China’s approval included customer-contract stipulations, and the first combined capabilities were planned for the first half of 2026, without confirmation here of delivery [f8329, f8879, f8535]. The corpus identifies the former Ansys sensor offering as Synopsys AVxcelerate Sensors, a commercial sensor-simulation tool rather than a complete platform, covering camera, lidar, radar and thermal simulation for SIL/HIL testing, with documented CarMaker and CARLA co-simulation [f15917, f8531, f15946]. Camera simulation requires physical sky, lights and surface optical properties, while the 2025 R1 release exposes lidar material, BRDF and atmospheric parameters; these input capabilities do not independently establish simulation accuracy [f3940, f3927]. Historical Ansys/NVIDIA GTC 2020 vendor figures report 14 hours on a workstation for a CPU SBR solver to process a 12-second scenario, versus about 12 ms per frame for a GPU real-time radar SBR version against a 30 fps target; these are vendor-reported figures for different versions, not an independently established current performance guarantee [f4931, f4932].
